title: SeismicPreStackProcessingProduct
description: A singular pre-stack output from a seismic processing project, encompassing one or many sections and/or volumes.

id.description: Previously called ResourceID or SRN which identifies this OSDU resource object without version.
id.title: Entity ID

kind.description: The schema identification for the OSDU resource object following the pattern {Namespace}:{Source}:{Type}:{VersionMajor}.{VersionMinor}.{VersionPatch}. The versioning scheme follows the semantic versioning, https://semver.org/.
kind.title: Entity Kind

version.description: The version number of this OSDU resource; set by the framework.
version.title: Version Number

acl.description: The access control tags associated with this entity.
acl.title: Access Control List

legal.description: The entity's legal tags and compliance status. The actual contents associated with the legal tags is managed by the Compliance Service.
legal.title: Legal Tags

tags.title: Tag Dictionary
tags.description: A generic dictionary of string keys mapping to string value. Only strings are permitted as keys and values.

createTime.description: Timestamp of the time at which initial version of this OSDU resource object was created. Set by the System. The value is a combined date-time string in ISO-8601 given in UTC.
createTime.title: Resource Object Creation DateTime

createUser.title: Resource Object Creation User Reference
createUser.description: The user reference, which created the first version of this resource object. Set by the System.

modifyTime.description: Timestamp of the time at which this version of the OSDU resource object was created. Set by the System. The value is a combined date-time string in ISO-8601 given in UTC.
modifyTime.title: Resource Object Version Creation DateTime

modifyUser.title: Resource Object Version Creation User Reference
modifyUser.description: The user reference, which created this version of this resource object. Set by the System.

ancestry.description: The links to data, which constitute the inputs, from which this record instance is derived.
ancestry.title: Ancestry

meta.description: The Frame of Reference meta data section linking the named properties to self-contained definitions.
meta.title: Frame of Reference Meta Data

PrincipalAcquisitionProjectID.description: For most datasets, the acquisition project that generated the underlying field data.  For merges, probably absent (see processing project for set of acquisition projects used in processing this dataset).

ProcessingProjectID.description: The processing project from which this trace dataset was produced.  Absent for field data.

ContractIDs.description: References to applicable agreements in external contract database system of record.

SeismicTraceDataDimensionalityTypeID.description: The dimensionality of trace data sets (not as acquired but as in the dataset), such as 2D, 3D, 4D.

SeismicDomainTypeID.description: ID of the nature of the vertical axis in the trace data set, usually Depth or Time.

SeismicMigrationTypeID.description: ID of the Seismic Migration Data Type

SeismicStackingTypeID.description: ID of the Seismic Stacking Type

SeismicAttributeTypeID.description: ID of the Seismic Trace Data Type

SeismicFilteringTypeID.description: ID of the Seismic Filtering Type

SeismicPhaseID.description: Reference to the reference-data--SeismicPhase value describing the wavelet phase as estimated/processed for this SeismicTraceData instance.

SeismicPolarityID.description: Reference to the reference-data--SeismicPolarity value describing the polarity for this SeismicTraceData instance.

SeismicProcessingStageTypeID.description: It specifies if the seismic is as acquired, or has been manipulated by a process or workflow before arriving at its current state.

SampleCount.description: Number of samples in the vertical direction.

Difference.description: Indicates if the volume is a product of the difference between 4D surveys

StartVerticalIndex.description: The sample axis value in the vertical dimension at which the data starts. Use SeismicDomainType to know if data is in time or depth.

EndVerticalIndex.description: The sample axis value in the vertical dimension at which the data ends. Use SeismicDomainType to know if data is in time or depth.

TraceCount.description: How many traces are in the volume

TraceLength.description: Maximum trace length calculated using depth or time start and end points as appropriate according to SeismicDomainType.

TraceDomainUOM.description: UOM for vertical trace domain values

VerticalDatumOffset.description: Datum value, the elevation of zero time/depth on the vertical axis in the domain of SeismicDomainType relative to the vertical reference datum used (usually MSL). Positive is upward from zero elevation to seismic datum).

VerticalMeasurementTypeID.description: Identifies a vertical reference datum type. E.g. mean sea level, ground level, mudline.

ReplacementVelocity.description: Value used to produce vertical static shifts in data

ShiftApplied.description: Indicates how much the data has been shifted from the Vertical Datum (seismic reference datum) in the domain and units of SeismicDomainType and in the sense that a positive number causes a sample to move downward in physical space (lower elevation).

ProcessingParameters.description: Processing Parameters to simply capture process history until full provenance model can be implemented.

items.title: ProcessingParameters
items.description: Processing Parameters to simply capture process history until full provenance model can be implemented.

ProcessingParameterValue.description: The quantity for the processing parameter. May include units, ordering, and other descriptions.

CoveragePercent.description: Actual nominal fold of the trace data set as processed, expressed as the mode in percentage points (60 fold = 6000%).

RangeAmplitudeMax.description: The actual maximum amplitude value found in the dataset.

RangeAmplitudeMin.description: The actual minimum amplitude value found in the dataset.

SeismicWaveTypeID.title: Seismic Wave Type ID
SeismicWaveTypeID.description: The observed wave mode type in this trace data set (P, Sv, etc).

PreStackAngleRanges.title: PreStack Angle Ranges
PreStackAngleRanges.description: Pre-stack: Sets of trace angle ranges contained within this data set.

items.title: AngleRange
items.description: A range container carrying minimum/maximum angle values.

PreStackAzimuthRanges.title: PreStack Azimuth Ranges
PreStackAzimuthRanges.description: Pre-stack: Sets of trace azimuth ranges contained within this data set.

items.title: AngleRange
items.description: A range container carrying minimum/maximum angle values.

PreStackOffsetRanges.title: PreStack Offset Ranges
PreStackOffsetRanges.description: Pre-stack: Sets of trace offset ranges contained within this data set.

items.title: LengthRange
items.description: A range container carrying minimum/maximum angle values.

GatherTypeID.title: Gather Type ID
GatherTypeID.description: Pre-stack: the type of gathers in this dataset.

DefinitiveProducts.description: References to the volume, volumes, and sections that represent the definitive collection. Generally will be the highest fidelity and largest coverage.

VelocityModelID.title: Velocity Model ID
VelocityModelID.description: The velocity model used in the creation of this trace dataset
